svg.title: Historical evolution of Cardano mainnet UTxO state and its reconstructed minimum-ada requirement
svg.desc: Four aligned charts cover epochs zero through 648: exact live UTxO count, exact creation and consumption flows shown as seven-epoch averages, sampled minimum-ada estimates under creation-era and current rules, and sampled stake-credential and active-snapshot shares.
svg.text: How the live state, its churn, and its ada floor evolved
Aligned time axes separate persistent stock from transaction flow and reconstructed economic incidence.
Epoch 649 excluded because it was incomplete · exact counts and flows · deterministic 1-in-500 structural estimates
